in_hebrew.name: Winfield
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Winfield הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Originally derived from the Old English words ‘wynn’ (friend) and ‘feld’ (open land, field). This name signifies a person who has a strong bond with the land and the people around them. In Christianity, it may symbolize the field of faith and the friend, Jesus Christ, who guides us through our spiritual journey.
